description: Department of Veterans Affairs, Office of Inspector General (VA‐OIG) intends to acquire “turn‐key” solutions for the purchase, delivery and installation of furniture and equipment.  This project is anticipated for delivery and installation of furniture to be completed for two separate installation dates, with the last date being November 30, 2026.  Review intermittent dates included within delivery schedule to be adhered too. The timeframe requirement for delivery receipt shall be no later than 75 business days following award of contract, with coordination of specific dates mutually agreed upon by the OIG Space Manager and the selected contractor - BRAND NAME OR EQUAL.
